evidence.note: the official declaration was not obtainable; see OFFICIAL_INACTIVES_CAPTURE_ATTEMPT.json. This entry records the claim and the missing capability, not a confirmed fact.

explicitly_not_done: no boost to DET offence in aggregate
no ad hoc defensive adjustment of any kind
no reweighting of any existing layer to stand in for one
future_input_to: matchup and OL-DL modelling. Registered owners already exist for the three effects so that a future producer has an owner before it has a consumer: ol_pass_protection_v1 and run_blocking_v1 under line_play, coverage_v1 under coverage.
known_data_obstacle: was_pressure is 404 for 2026 and publishes only after the postseason; defense_coverage_type comes from participation data on the same schedule. Gate IN_SEASON_PRESSURE_DATA is NO for this reason.
why_a_manual_boost_would_be_worse_than_n: a hand-applied edge has no prior, no out-of-sample test and no rollback, and once a projection has been nudged once, every later evaluation of this fixture measures the nudge as well as the model. An unmodelled effect that is NAMED can be built and tested; one that has been quietly absorbed into a number cannot.
why_it_is_football_evidence: an interior defensive lineman`s absence plausibly moves opposing rushing efficiency, pressure rate and therefore quarterback and back production. That is a real mechanism and it is the reason this is recorded rather than ignored.
why_nothing_moves_tonight: the system has NO governed DL, pass-rush or run-defence personnel adjustment. ownership_audit reports run_blocking_v1, ol_pass_protection_v1 and coverage_v1 all NOT_AVAILABLE with no producer, and opponent_rush_strength_v1 is RESEARCH_ONLY and additionally RUSH_OPPONENT_ADJUSTMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET on the frozen B0-B5 result. There is no calibrated path from "this lineman is out" to a player projection, so any number produced tonight would be invented.
